caption: The drawing is rendered in pencil on a light-colored, likely off-white or beige, background. It features two detailed depictions of the same ornamental comb. The larger central section of the drawing shows the comb horizontally, with intricately decorated, rounded top and eight long, evenly spaced tines extending downward. The upper part of the comb is elaborately designed with symmetrical floral and scroll motifs. In the top left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, vertical inset showing a side profile of the same comb, emphasizing the curvature and thickness of the upper section and the length of the tines. Both views are placed within lightly drawn rectangles, and there are a few small brown spots and mild discoloration on the paper. At the bottom edge, there is a handwritten note: "M.G. Ringak 1837".
title: Comb
